topic: Measurement of Breakdown voltage & potential barrier of a diode
syllabus_extract: Measurement of Breakdown voltage & potential barrier of a diode.
specific_objectives: 24.9.1.1 Trainee will be able to measure various parameters of diode characteristics.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Practical: Measurement of Breakdown voltage and potential barrier using a diode test kit. Safety: Ensure power supply is off before connecting circuit. Instructor supervision: Monitor connections and voltage readings during breakdown test.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of a PN junction diode?
Define the term 'potential barrier' in the context of a diode.
What happens to current flow when a diode is reverse biased below breakdown voltage?

topics: Circuit setup for forward bias characteristics
Plotting V-I curve for forward region
development.content:
Circuit setup for forward bias characteristics
Measurement of potential barrier voltage
Plotting V-I curve for forward region
Identification of knee voltage point
Recording threshold voltage values

topics: Circuit configuration for reverse bias test
development.content:
Circuit configuration for reverse bias test
Procedure for increasing reverse voltage
Observation of leakage current increase
Detection of sudden current surge
Recording breakdown voltage value

topics: Analysis of forward and reverse V-I curves
Comparison of potential barrier and breakdown voltage
development.content:
Analysis of forward and reverse V-I curves
Comparison of potential barrier and breakdown voltage
Interpretation of diode characteristic graph
Verification of measured parameters
Documentation of experimental results

summary_questions: Explain the relationship between potential barrier and forward bias voltage.
Describe the physical mechanism causing diode breakdown at high reverse voltage.
Differentiate between Zener breakdown and avalanche breakdown based on voltage levels.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report comparing the V-I characteristics of a silicon diode and a germanium diode, highlighting differences in potential barrier and breakdown voltage, to be used in the next lesson on transistor characteristics.
